$comment: Samples excluded from FRAMEWORK pass/fail accounting because the failure is the sample's or upstream's fault, not an Extension.js defect. Each was verified by hand (see category/reason). run-matrix records these as skip:<category> and does not build them; report.mjs excludes them so the framework pass-rate reflects only what Extension.js is responsible for. Revisit when upstream changes: drop an entry to let a sample re-enter the matrix. Every entry carries the dated rerun that last proved its cause; an entry without one has not been re-verified.

mdn/mocha-client-tests/addon.reason: upstream MDN commits an invalid 8KB browser-polyfill.min.js (node --check rejects it); builds fine with the genuine file (see bug-reports/01)
mdn/mocha-client-tests/addon.verified: 2026-11-14 extension@4.1.39: fails on chrome, firefox and edge, the bundler stops on a parse error inside browser-polyfill.min.js (Build failed with 2 errors)

mdn/webpack-modules/addon.verified: 2026-11-14 extension@4.1.39: fails on chrome, firefox and edge, background.scripts NOT FOUND background_scripts/index.js
